snippet.title: AMC Squad Episode 4: The Law of Knights Community Trailer
snippet.description:
https://www.moddb.com/games/the-amc-tc

The squad travels to a distant location known only as Elysion, where an ancient foe awaits. Shot down by mysterious means, they must travel this vast location and not only put a stop to the Necromancer's plans, but also find a way home. Joined by their newest member, the demon huntress Kagura and her talking sword Yo, they soon uncover the secrets of their remote destination...
​
​Will they make it out of this strange new world?
​Find out in Episode 4 of the AMC Squad!

This Community Trailer was created as a means of garnering attention towards a group of ambitious Indie Developers, as i'm not 'Officially' associated with them & I've only made them to 'Spread the Word' as it were.

#AMCTC
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Song Composed by Antii Martikainen Music
(Truly, The Lords of Celtic Metal)
